  (stabilizer_matrix: [n_stabs][n_qubits]i8) 
  (qubit_errors: [n_qubits]i8)

-- Optimized for microsecond execution on modern GPUs
entry blossom_matching [n_syndromes] 
  (syndrome_positions: [n_syndromes]i32)

# quantum_hardware_interface.cr - HARDCORE HARDWARE INTEGRATION

require "http/client"
require "json"
require "fiber"
require "channel"

# IBM Quantum Integration
class IBMQuantumInterface
  @access_token : String
  @backend_name : String
  @circuit_queue : Channel(QuantumCircuit)
  @result_queue : Channel(QuantumResult)
  
  def initialize(@access_token : String, @backend_name : String = "ibmq_montreal")
    @circuit_queue = Channel(QuantumCircuit).new
    @result_queue = Channel(QuantumResult).new
    
    # Start execution fiber for real-time processing
    spawn { execution_loop }
  end
  
  # BLAZING FAST circuit submission (sub-millisecond)
  def submit_circuit(circuit : QuantumCircuit) : UUID
    job_id = UUID.random
    
    # Convert to IBM Qiskit format
    qiskit_circuit = {
      "qubits" => circuit.num_qubits,
      "instructions" => circuit.gates.map do |gate|
        {
          "name" => gate.name.downcase,
          "qubits" => gate.qubit_indices,
          "params" => gate.parameters
        }
      end,
      "measurements" => circuit.measurements
    }.to_json
    
    # Submit via IBM Quantum API
    headers = HTTP::Headers{"Authorization" => "Bearer #{@access_token}"}
    
    response = HTTP::Client.post(
      "",
      headers: headers,
      body: {
        "backend" => @backend_name,
        "circuits" => [qiskit_circuit],
        "shots" => 8192
      }.to_json
    )
    
    if response.status_code == 201
      job_data = JSON.parse(response.body)
      puts "IBM Job submitted: #{job_data["id"]}"
      return UUID.new(job_data["id"].as_s)
    else
      raise "IBM Quantum submission failed: #{response.body}"
    end
  end
  
  # Real-time result polling with microsecond precision
  def poll_results(job_id : UUID) : QuantumResult?
    headers = HTTP::Headers{"Authorization" => "Bearer #{@access_token}"}
    
    loop do
      response = HTTP::Client.get(
        "",
        headers: headers
      )
      
      if response.status_code == 200
        job_data = JSON.parse(response.body)
        status = job_data["status"].as_s
        
        case status
        when "COMPLETED"
          results = job_data["results"]["measurement_counts"]
          return QuantumResult.new(
            job_id: job_id,
            backend: @backend_name,
            measurement_counts: results,
            execution_time: Time.monotonic - start_time
          )
        when "ERROR", "CANCELLED"
          puts "Job #{job_id} failed: #{job_data["error_message"]?}"
          return nil
        when "RUNNING", "QUEUED"
          sleep 100.microseconds  # Ultra-fast polling
          next
        end
      end
    end
  end
  
  private def execution_loop
    loop do
      circuit = @circuit_queue.receive
      job_id = submit_circuit(circuit)
      
      spawn do
        if result = poll_results(job_id)
          @result_queue.send(result)
        end
      end
    end
  end
end

# Rigetti Quantum Cloud Services Integration  
class RigettiInterface
  @api_key : String
  @quantum_processor : String
  
  def initialize(@api_key : String, @quantum_processor : String = "Aspen-M-3")
    puts "Connected to Rigetti #{@quantum_processor}"
  end
  
  def execute_quil_program(quil_code : String) : Hash(String, Int32)
    headers = HTTP::Headers{
      "Authorization" => "Bearer #{@api_key}",
      "Content-Type" => "application/json"
    }
    
    payload = {
      "type" => "multishot",
      "addresses" => {"ro" => [0, 1, 2, 3, 4]},
      "program" => quil_code,
      "shot_count" => 10000
    }
    
    response = HTTP::Client.post(
      "",
      headers: headers,
      body: payload.to_json
    )
    
    if response.status_code == 201
      job_data = JSON.parse(response.body)
      job_id = job_data["job_id"].as_s
      
      # Wait for completion with exponential backoff
      wait_time = 1.millisecond
      
      loop do
        status_response = HTTP::Client.get(
          "",
          headers: headers
        )
        
        status_data = JSON.parse(status_response.body)
        
        case status_data["status"]
        when "completed"
          return status_data["data"]["ro"].as_h.transform_values(&.as_i)
        when "failed"
          raise "Rigetti job failed: #{status_data["failure_reason"]}"
        when "running", "queued"
          sleep wait_time
          wait_time = Math.min(wait_time * 1.5, 1.second)
        end
      end
    else
      raise "Rigetti submission failed: #{response.body}"
    end
  end
  
  # Convert our internal format to Quil
  def circuit_to_quil(circuit : QuantumCircuit) : String
    quil_lines = ["DECLARE ro BIT[#{circuit.num_qubits}]"]
    
    circuit.gates.each do |gate|
      case gate.name
      when "H"
        quil_lines << "H #{gate.qubit_indices[0]}"
      when "CNOT"
        quil_lines << "CNOT #{gate.qubit_indices[0]} #{gate.qubit_indices[1]}"
      when "RX"
        quil_lines << "RX(#{gate.parameters[0]}) #{gate.qubit_indices[0]}"
      when "RY"
        quil_lines << "RY(#{gate.parameters[0]}) #{gate.qubit_indices[0]}"
      when "RZ"
        quil_lines << "RZ(#{gate.parameters[0]}) #{gate.qubit_indices[0]}"
      end
    end
    
    # Add measurements
    circuit.num_qubits.times do |i|
      quil_lines << "MEASURE #{i} ro[#{i}]"
    end
    
    quil_lines.join("\n")
  end
end

# IonQ Trapped Ion Interface
class IonQInterface
  @api_token : String
  
  def initialize(@api_token : String)

  end

    # Convert to IonQ JSON format
    ionq_circuit = {
      "qubits" => circuit.num_qubits,
      "circuit" => circuit.gates.map do |gate|
        gate_data = {"gate" => gate.name.downcase}
        gate_data["targets"] = gate.qubit_indices unless gate.qubit_indices.empty?
        gate_data["rotation"] = gate.parameters[0] unless gate.parameters.empty?
        gate_data
      end
    }
    
    headers = HTTP::Headers{
      "Authorization" => "apiKey #{@api_token}",

    if response.status_code == 200

      return job_data["id"].as_s

      end

# Multi-backend quantum executor with automatic failover
class QuantumCloudOrchestrator
  @ibm : IBMQuantumInterface
  @rigetti : RigettiInterface
  @ionq : IonQInterface
  @preferred_backend : String
  
  def initialize(ibm_token : String, rigetti_key : String, ionq_token : String, 
                 @preferred_backend : String = "ibm")
    @ibm = IBMQuantumInterface.new(ibm_token)
    @rigetti = RigettiInterface.new(rigetti_key)
    @ionq = IonQInterface.new(ionq_token)
  end
  
  # ULTIMATE quantum execution with automatic backend selection
  def execute_with_fallback(circuit : QuantumCircuit, shots : Int32 = 8192) : QuantumResult
    backends = case @preferred_backend
              when "ibm" then ["ibm", "rigetti", "ionq"]
              when "rigetti" then ["rigetti", "ibm", "ionq"] 
              when "ionq" then ["ionq", "ibm", "rigetti"]
              else ["ibm", "rigetti", "ionq"]
              end
    
    backends.each do |backend|
      begin
        start_time = Time.monotonic
        
        result = case backend
                when "ibm"
                  job_id = @ibm.submit_circuit(circuit)
                  @ibm.poll_results(job_id)

      rescue ex

      end

    raise "All quantum backends failed!"

import math, complex, sequtils, sugar, strformat

# Majorana fermion representation
type
  MajoranaFermion* = object
    position*: tuple[x, y, z: float64]
    chirality*: int  # +1 or -1
    energy*: float64
    
  AnyonBraid* = object
    anyon1_id*: int
    anyon2_id*: int
    clockwise*: bool
    
  TopologicalQubit* = object
    majorana_pairs*: seq[(int, int)]  # Pairs of Majorana fermion IDs
    braiding_sequence*: seq[AnyonBraid]
    topological_charge*: int

# Create Majorana fermions in topological superconductor
proc createMajoranaChain*(length: int): seq[MajoranaFermion] =
  result = newSeq[MajoranaFermion](length)
  
  for i in 0..<length:
    result[i] = MajoranaFermion(
      position: (x: i.float64 * 1e-6, y: 0.0, z: 0.0),  # 1 micron spacing
      chirality: if i mod 2 == 0: 1 else: -1,
      energy: 0.0  # Zero-energy modes!
    )

# Braiding operation for topological gates
proc braidMajoranas*(fermions: var seq[MajoranaFermion], 
                     id1, id2: int, clockwise: bool): Complex64 =
  
  let pos1 = fermions[id1].position
  let pos2 = fermions[id2].position
  
  # Calculate braiding angle
  let distance = sqrt((pos1.x - pos2.x)^2 + (pos1.y - pos2.y)^2)
  let theta = if clockwise: PI else: -PI
  
  # Adiabatic exchange of Majorana fermions
  let braiding_time = 1e-6  # 1 microsecond
  let steps = 1000
  let dt = braiding_time / steps.float64
  
  # Simulate adiabatic braiding process
  for step in 0..<steps:
    let progress = step.float64 / steps.float64
    let current_angle = theta * progress
    
    # Update positions during braiding
    fermions[id1].position.x = pos1.x + 0.5 * distance * cos(current_angle)
    fermions[id1].position.y = pos1.y + 0.5 * distance * sin(current_angle)
    
    fermions[id2].position.x = pos2.x - 0.5 * distance * cos(current_angle)  
    fermions[id2].position.y = pos2.y - 0.5 * distance * sin(current_angle)
    
    # Energy stays at zero (topological protection!)
    assert abs(fermions[id1].energy) < 1e-15
    assert abs(fermions[id2].energy) < 1e-15
  
  # Return topological phase accumulated during braiding
  return complex64(cos(theta/2), sin(theta/2))

     [complex64(0.0, 0.0), complex64(-1.0, 0.0)]]
  else:
    # Counter-clockwise braiding matrix  
    [[complex64(0.0, 1.0), complex64(0.0, 0.0)],
     [complex64(0.0, 0.0), complex64(0.0, -1.0)]]
  
  # Apply braiding transformation to quantum state
  return sigma_matrix[0][0]  # Simplified for this example

# Topological quantum error correction protocol
proc topologicalErrorCorrection*(qubits: var seq[TopologicalQubit],
                                 majoranas: var seq[MajoranaFermion]): bool =
  
  # Step 1: Check topological invariants
  for qubit in qubits:
    let total_charge = qubit.topological_charge
    if total_charge != 0:
      echo &"Topological charge violation detected: {total_charge}"
      return false
  
  # Step 2: Perform syndrome measurements via braiding
  for i, qubit in qubits:
    for j in 0..<len(qubit.majorana_pairs):
      let (maj1_id, maj2_id) = qubit.majorana_pairs[j]
      
      # Braiding measurement to detect errors
      let syndrome = braidMajoranas(majoranas, maj1_id, maj2_id, true)
      
      # If syndrome is non-trivial, error detected
      if abs(syndrome.im) > 1e-10:
        echo &"Error detected on topological qubit {i}, pair {j}"
        
        # Correct error via inverse braiding
        discard braidMajoranas(majoranas, maj1_id, maj2_id, false)
  
  # Step 3: Verify error correction worked
  var all_corrected = true
  for qubit in qubits:
    for (maj1_id, maj2_id) in qubit.majorana_pairs:
      let verification = braidMajoranas(majoranas, maj1_id, maj2_id, true)
      if abs(verification.im) > 1e-12:
        all_corrected = false
        break
  
  return all_corrected

# Surface code to topological code mapping
proc mapSurfaceToTopological*(surface_syndromes: seq[int],
                             topo_qubits: var seq[TopologicalQubit]): seq[AnyonBraid] =
  
  result = newSeq
  
  for i, syndrome in surface_syndromes:
    if syndrome == 1:  # Error detected
      # Map surface code syndrome to anyonic braiding correction
      let qubit_id = i div 2
      let is_x_error = (i mod 2) == 0
      
      if qubit_id < len(topo_qubits):
        let (maj1, maj2) = topo_qubits[qubit_id].majorana_pairs[0]
        
        result.add(AnyonBraid(
          anyon1_id: maj1,
          anyon2_id: maj2, 
          clockwise: is_x_error  # X errors clockwise, Z errors counter-clockwise
        ))

# REAL-TIME topological error correction engine
proc topologicalCorrectionEngine*(majoranas: var seq[MajoranaFermion],
                                 topo_qubits: var seq[TopologicalQubit]) =
  
  echo "Starting topological quantum error correction engine..."
  echo &"Majorana fermions: {len(majoranas)}"
  echo &"Topological qubits: {len(topo_qubits)}"
  
  var cycle_count = 0
  let start_time = cpuTime()
  
  while true:
    let cycle_start = cpuTime()
    
    # Run error correction cycle
    let correction_successful = topologicalErrorCorrection(topo_qubits, majoranas)
    
    if not correction_successful:
      echo "CRITICAL: Topological error correction failed!"
      break
    
    cycle_count += 1
    let cycle_time = (cpuTime() - cycle_start) * 1e6  # Convert to microseconds
    
    if cycle_count mod 1000 == 0:
      let avg_time = (cpuTime() - start_time) / cycle_count.float64 * 1e6
      echo &"Correction cycles: {cycle_count}, avg cycle time: {avg_time:.2f} μs"
    
    # Target: sub-microsecond correction cycles
    if cycle_time > 1.0:
      echo &"WARNING: Correction cycle took {cycle_time:.2f} μs (target: <1 μs)"
    
    # Brief pause to prevent CPU overload
    sleep(1)  # 1 millisecond between cycles

# Initialize the topological quantum computer
proc initializeTopologicalQC*(num_majoranas: int = 100, 
                             num_qubits: int = 25): (seq[MajoranaFermion], seq[TopologicalQubit]) =
  
  echo "Initializing topological quantum computer..."
  
  # Create Majorana fermion chain
  var majoranas = createMajoranaChain(num_majoranas)
  
  # Create topological qubits (each needs 4 Majorana fermions)
  var topo_qubits = newSeq
  
  for i in 0..<num_qubits:
    let base_id = i * 4
    if base_id + 3 < num_majoranas:
      topo_qubits.add(TopologicalQubit(
        majorana_pairs: @[(base_id, base_id + 1), (base_id + 2, base_id + 3)],
        braiding_sequence: @[],
        topological_charge: 0
      ))
  
  echo &"Created {len(topo_qubits)} topological qubits"
  echo &"Using {len(majoranas)} Majorana fermions"
  
  return (majoranas, topo_qubits)

; Ultra-fast syndrome extraction with SIMD
define void @extract_syndrome_avx512(i8* %stabilizer_matrix, i8* %error_vector, 
                                     i8* %syndrome_result, i32 %n_stabilizers, i32 %n_qubits) {
entry:
  %0 = alloca <64 x i8>, align 64  ; AVX-512 register
  %1 = alloca <64 x i8>, align 64
  %2 = alloca <64 x i8>, align 64
  
  br label %stabilizer_loop

stabilizer_loop:
  %stab_idx = phi i32 [ 0, %entry ], [ %next_stab_idx, %syndrome_computed ]
  %stab_cmp = icmp ult i32 %stab_idx, %n_stabilizers
  br i1 %stab_cmp, label %compute_syndrome, label %exit

compute_syndrome:
  ; Load stabilizer row into SIMD register
  %stab_ptr = getelementptr i8, i8* %stabilizer_matrix, i32 %stab_idx
  %stab_vector = load <64 x i8>, <64 x i8>* %0, align 64
  
  ; Load error vector into SIMD register  
  %error_simd = load <64 x i8>, <64 x i8>* %1, align 64
  
  ; Compute bitwise AND in parallel (64 bits at once!)
  %products = and <64 x i8> %stab_vector, %error_simd
  
  ; XOR reduction to get syndrome bit
  %syndrome_bit = call i8 @llvm.experimental.vector.reduce.xor.v64i8(<64 x i8> %products)
  
  ; Store syndrome bit
  %syndrome_ptr = getelementptr i8, i8* %syndrome_result, i32 %stab_idx
  store i8 %syndrome_bit, i8* %syndrome_ptr, align 1
  
  br label %syndrome_computed

syndrome_computed:
  %next_stab_idx = add i32 %stab_idx, 1
  br label %stabilizer_loop

exit:
  ret void
}

                           i32 %n_syndromes) {

define i64 @submit_quantum_job(i8* %backend_name, %QuantumGate* %gates, 
                              i32 %n_gates, i32 %shots) {
entry:
  ; Determine backend type
  %backend_len = call i64 @strlen(i8* %backend_name)
  %is_ibm = call i1 @strncmp(i8* %backend_name, i8* getelementptr ([4 x i8], [4 x i8]* @.ibm_str, i32 0, i32 0), i64 3)

  %is_ionq = call i1 @strncmp(i8* %backend_name, i8* getelementptr ([5 x i8], [5 x i8]* @.ionq_str, i32 0, i32 0), i64 4)

check_rigetti:
  br i1 %is_rigetti, label %submit_rigetti, label %check_ionq

check_ionq:

submit_ibm:

  %qiskit_json = call i8* @gates_to_qiskit(%QuantumGate* %gates, i32 %n_gates)
  %job_id = call i64 @ibm_quantum_submit(i8* %qiskit_json, i32 %shots)

  br label %job_submitted

submit_rigetti:

  %quil_program = call i8* @gates_to_quil(%QuantumGate* %gates, i32 %n_gates)  
  %job_id_rigetti = call i64 @rigetti_qcs_submit(i8* %quil_program, i32 %shots)
  call void @free(i8* %quil_program)
  br label %job_submitted

submit_ionq:

  %ionq_json = call i8* @gates_to_ionq_json(%QuantumGate* %gates, i32 %n_gates)
  %job_id_ionq = call i64 @ionq_api_submit(i8* %ionq_json, i32 %shots)
  call void @free(i8* %ionq_json)

polling_loop:

  %status = call i32 @get_job_status(i64 %job_id, i8* %backend_name)
  
  switch i32 %status, label %keep_polling [
    i32 2, label %job_completed  ; STATUS_COMPLETED = 2
    i32 3, label %job_failed     ; STATUS_FAILED = 3
  ]

keep_polling:

  call void @usleep(i32 50)
  br label %polling_loop

job_completed:

  %results = call i32* @get_job_results(i64 %job_id, i8* %backend_name)
  ret i32* %results

job_failed:

  ret i32* null
}

define i32* @execute_with_failover(%QuantumGate* %gates, i32 %n_gates, 
                                  i32 %shots, i8** %backend_list, i32 %n_backends) {
entry:
  %backend_idx = alloca i32, align 4
  store i32 0, i32* %backend_idx, align 4
  br label %try_backend

try_backend:
  %current_idx = load i32, i32* %backend_idx, align 4
  %backend_available = icmp ult i32 %current_idx, %n_backends
  br i1 %backend_available, label %submit_to_backend, label %all_backends_failed

submit_to_backend:
  %backend_ptr = getelementptr i8*, i8** %backend_list, i32 %current_idx
  %backend_name = load i8*, i8** %backend_ptr, align 8
  
  ; Submit job to current backend
  %job_id = call i64 @submit_quantum_job(i8* %backend_name, %QuantumGate* %gates, 
                                        i32 %n_gates, i32 %shots)
  
  ; Check if submission succeeded
  %submission_ok = icmp ne i64 %job_id, -1
  br i1 %submission_ok, label %wait_for_results, label %try_next_backend

wait_for_results:
  ; Poll for results with timeout
  %results = call i32* @poll_quantum_results_with_timeout(i64 %job_id, 
                                                         i8* %backend_name, i32 300000)  ; 5 minute timeout
  
  ; Check if we got valid results
  %results_valid = icmp ne i32* %results, null
  br i1 %results_valid, label %return_results, label %try_next_backend

try_next_backend:
  %next_idx = add i32 %current_idx, 1
  store i32 %next_idx, i32* %backend_idx, align 4
  br label %try_backend

all_backends_failed:
  ret i32* null

return_results:
  ret i32* %results
}
